entity_assignment: Map188 source drugs to185 conservative parent-connectivity groups; sort groups by SHA256(seed|parent:sha256(parent_smiles)), round-robin5folds; all doses/contexts/aliases stay together
aliases: RDKit LargestFragmentChooser(preferOrganic=True), Uncharger, MolToSmiles(canonical=True,isomericSmiles=False) solely for split grouping. Three pairs grouped: ENMD2076 salts, valproate salts, Ruxolitinib stereoisomers. Preserve original188 sources/fullstructureMorgan. No tautomer/scaffold/family holdout.
comparators: Same query subsets of frozen original 21 shared-method seen-entity LOCO predictions, no original refit
gene_panel: Original source-two-line control-A panels for both new tasks and reused comparator
training_counts: All other entities in 3 contexts for seen-context task, 2 contexts for joint holdout; report counts, no causal interpretation of score difference
metrics: Original condition MAE/RMSE/Spearman; fixed context/time/dose gene Spearman and pair order only within each entity-fold model; require >=20 unique source drugs AND >=20 parentgroups. Distinct source compounds retain original descriptive weighting; aliases are not independent biological replicates.
aggregation: Equal dose within entity fold, equal entity fold then equal cell line; no cross-model out-of-fold pooled rank; one study, one entity partition
input_state: Physical A available only to __control_state methods; physical B only in response targets
unknown_identity: Unseen drug entity block all zero, seen dose one-hot retained; direct predictions at fixed dose must be identical
restricted_cohort: Score pre-existing restricted conditions without refitting
scope: Retrospective single-study stress test. No same-drug response baseline for unseen entities. Chemical structure is additional input, not equal-information LLM comparison.
